summary: PIMCO High Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting a change in its principal investment strategy, effective June 24, 2026, to permit investing in and/or originating loans, including residential/commercial real estate, consumer, and other loans, without borrower credit criteria. Effective July 24, 2026, the fund may invest without limitation in bank loans. This is a routine disclosure of a prospectus supplement altering investment parameters, not a special situation event. No deal terms, shareholder vote, or strategic corporate action is involved. Watch for any future regulatory or liquidity impacts from expanded credit-risk exposure.
